description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Booz Allen Hamilton is hiring a junior software developer to develop, enhance, and maintain client software and applications. The role includes troubleshooting operational issues, upgrading systems to meet security requirements, and supporting clients as they improve and modernize existing systems.
Junior Software Developer supporting client Java applications through development and maintenance, operational troubleshooting, and security upgrades

Responsibilities:
• As a software developer on our team, you will learn to develop and enhance client software using technologies and languages such as Java
• Join our team and help turn requirements into accomplishments that drive change
• Supporting a team of professionals, you’ll help maintain applications and keep systems working
• You’ll use programming and scripting languages as you continuously enhance and maintain the applications, troubleshoot any issues that arise operationally, and upgrade the systems to meet security requirements
• Most importantly, you’ll learn how we advise our clients on the best ways to improve and modernize the existing systems
• Work with us to help us secure crucial systems while watching them grow and modernize

Requirements:
• Experience with software engineering and development in a professional work environment
• Experience with basic programming languages, technologies, tools, or web development stacks
• Knowledge of object-oriented programming in Java
• Ability to create solutions within a collaborative, cross-functional team
• Ability to gather and analyze requirements and develop technical deliverables
• Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
• HS diploma or GED

Preferred:
• 3+ years of experience in software development in an Agile environment
• Experience with networking protocols and applications
• Experience with Rust Programming language
• Knowledge of databases
• Knowledge of source control systems such as GIT
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and collaborative team environment
• Secret clearance
• Bachelor's degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) field
